s0201.literal: On jiazi day the five-zhu coins were recast.
s0201.idiomatic: On jiazi day the court recast five-zhu coin.

s0202.literal: In the third month, on jingzi day, the King of Ancheng, Xu, arrived from Zhou; an edict appointed him Palace Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, and Central Guard General, and set up aides and clerks.
s0202.idiomatic: In the third month, on jingzi day, the King of Ancheng, Xu, returned from Northern Zhou; an edict named him palace attendant, director of the secretariat, and central guard general, with staff appointed.

s0203.literal: On dingchou day Wu Mingche, General Who Pacifies the Right, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou, to take overall command of the armies in the southern campaign.
s0203.idiomatic: On dingchou day Wu Mingche, general who pacifies the right, was made general who pacifies the south and inspector of Jiangzhou, commanding the southern expedition.

s0204.literal: On jiashen day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0204.idiomatic: On jiashen day the throne proclaimed a general amnesty.

s0205.literal: On gengyin day Minister of Works Hou Andu defeated Liu Yi at Peach Branch Ridge; [16] Yi escaped and fled to Jin'an, and Dongyang commandery was pacified.
s0205.idiomatic: On gengyin day Hou Andu, minister of works, routed Liu Yi at Peach Branch Ridge; [16] Yi fled to Jin'an, and Dongyang commandery was pacified.

s0206.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on guimao day, a partial amnesty was granted to Dongyang commandery.
s0206.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guimao day, Dongyang commandery received a partial amnesty.

s0207.literal: On yisi day Qi sent envoys on a friendly mission.
s0207.idiomatic: On yisi day Northern Qi sent envoys on a friendly visit.

s0208.literal: In the sixth month, on jingchen day, the King of Ancheng, Xu, Palace Attendant and Central Guard General, was made Grand General of Cavalry and Inspector of Yangzhou.
s0208.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jingchen day, the King of Ancheng, Xu, palace attendant and central guard general, was made grand general of cavalry and inspector of Yangzhou.

s0209.literal: The eight commanderies Kuaiji, Dongyang, Linhai, Yongjia, Xin'an, Xinning, Jin'an, and Jian'an were grouped to form East Yangzhou.
s0209.idiomatic: Eight commanderies—Kuaiji, Dongyang, Linhai, Yongjia, Xin'an, Xinning, Jin'an, and Jian'an—were combined into East Yangzhou.

s0210.literal: The King of Shixing, Boma, Inspector of Yangzhou, was made General Who Guards the East and Inspector of East Yangzhou; Hou Andu, General Who Campaigns North, Minister of Works, and Inspector of South Xuzhou, was made Palace Attendant and Grand General Who Campaigns North.
s0210.idiomatic: The King of Shixing, Boma, inspector of Yangzhou, became general who guards the east and inspector of East Yangzhou; Hou Andu, general who campaigns north, minister of works, and inspector of South Xuzhou, became palace attendant and grand general who campaigns north.

s0211.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jichou day, the crown prince took Lady Wang as consort.
s0211.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jichou day, the crown prince married Lady Wang.

s0212.literal: Civil and military officials in post were each granted silk according to rank; those noted for filial piety, brotherly duty, and farming vigor who were heirs received two ranks of nobility.
s0212.idiomatic: Serving officials received graded gifts of silk; men honored for filial piety, brotherly conduct, and farming who were family heirs received two ranks of nobility.

s0213.literal: In the ninth month, on wuchen, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
s0213.idiomatic: On wuchen, the new moon of the ninth month, there was a solar eclipse.

s0214.literal: Palace Attendant and Minister of Justice Dao Zhongju was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Danyang.
s0214.idiomatic: Dao Zhongju, palace attendant and minister of justice, was made right vice director of the masters of writing and governor of Danyang.

s0215.literal: On dinghai day Zhou Di requested surrender; an edict ordered the King of Ancheng, Xu, to take overall command of the armies to receive and settle him.
s0215.idiomatic: On dinghai day Zhou Di offered to surrender; an edict ordered the King of Ancheng, Xu, to command the armies that would take him in.

s0216.literal: That year Xiao Cha, the Liang king installed by Zhou, died, and his son Kui succeeded him.
s0216.idiomatic: That year Xiao Cha, the Liang ruler Zhou had set up, died; his son Kui succeeded him.

s0217.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on jingzi day, the state of Gandhara sent envoys presenting local products.
s0217.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on jingzi day, Gandhara sent envoys with tribute.

s0218.literal: On jiashen day Zhou Di abandoned the city and fled; Minzhou Inspector Chen Baoying received him, and Linchuan commandery was pacified.
s0218.idiomatic: On jiashen day Zhou Di abandoned his city and fled; Chen Baoying, inspector of Minzhou, took him in, and Linchuan commandery was pacified.

s0219.literal: On renchen day Zhang Zhaoda, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yingzhou, was made Protector General; Hua Jiao, Benevolent and Martial General and Inspector of Xinzhou, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the South; Huang Fahe, General Who Guards the South with staff equal to the three counsellors and Inspector of Gaozhou, was made Grand General Who Guards the North and Inspector of South Xuzhou; Zhou Fu, General Who Pacifies the West and concurrent Inspector of Linchuan, was made Inspector of South Yuzhou; and Central Bulwark General Sun Yang was made General Who Guards the Right.
s0219.idiomatic: On renchen day Zhang Zhaoda, general who pacifies the west and inspector of Yingzhou, became protector general; Hua Jiao, benevolent and martial general and inspector of Xinzhou, was promoted to general who pacifies the south; Huang Fahe, general who guards the south with staff equal to the three counsellors and inspector of Gaozhou, became grand general who guards the north and inspector of South Xuzhou; Zhou Fu, general who pacifies the west and concurrent inspector of Linchuan, became inspector of South Yuzhou; and central bulwark general Sun Yang became general who guards the right.

s0220.literal: Gaozhou was abolished and merged into Jiangzhou.
s0220.idiomatic: Gaozhou was abolished and placed under Jiangzhou.

s0221.literal: In the second month, on wuxu day, Ouyang Yi, General Who Campaigns South with staff equal to the three counsellors and Inspector of Guangzhou, was advanced to Grand General Who Campaigns South.
s0221.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuxu day, Ouyang Yi, general who campaigns south with staff equal to the three counsellors and inspector of Guangzhou, was promoted to grand general who campaigns south.

s0222.literal: On gengxu day Hou Andu, Palace Attendant, Minister of Works, and Grand General Who Campaigns North, was made Grand General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Jiangzhou.
s0222.idiomatic: On gengxu day Hou Andu, palace attendant, minister of works, and grand general who campaigns north, was made grand general who campaigns south and inspector of Jiangzhou.

s0223.literal: On gengshen day Hua Jiao, General Who Pacifies the South, was made Inspector of South Xiangzhou.
s0223.idiomatic: On gengshen day Hua Jiao, general who pacifies the south, was made inspector of South Xiangzhou.

s0225.literal: In the third month, on xinwei day, Xu Du, General Who Guards the South with staff equal to the three counsellors, was made Palace Attendant and Grand General of the Central Army.
s0225.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei day, Xu Du, general who guards the south with staff equal to the three counsellors, was made palace attendant and grand general of the central army.

s0226.literal: On xinsi day an edict granted posthumous honors to officers and soldiers who died in service campaigning against Zhou Di.
s0226.idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict honored officers and soldiers who fell campaigning against Zhou Di.

s0227.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on xinchou day, a universal assembly without hindrance was held in the Hall of the Supreme Ultimate.
s0227.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinchou day, a great Buddhist assembly without hindrance was held before the Hall of the Supreme Ultimate.

s0228.literal: On yimao day the King of Ancheng, Xu, Palace Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, Central Guard General, Grand General of Cavalry, and Inspector of Yangzhou, was given the staff of office equal to the three counsellors.
s0228.idiomatic: On yimao day the King of Ancheng, Xu, palace attendant, director of the secretariat, central guard general, grand general of cavalry, and inspector of Yangzhou, received staff equal to the three counsellors.

s0229.literal: In the fifth month, on dingmao day, Xu Shipu, General Who Pacifies the Van and Right Director of the Masters of Writing for Splendid Happiness, died.
s0229.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingmao day, Xu Shipu, general who pacifies the van and right director of the masters of writing for splendid happiness, died.

s0230.literal: In the sixth month, on guisi day, the Metal Star was seen in daylight.
s0230.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guisi day, Venus appeared by day.

s0231.literal: Minister of Works Hou Andu was ordered to commit suicide.
s0231.idiomatic: Hou Andu, minister of works, was ordered to take his own life.

s0232.literal: In the seventh month, on dingchou day, Huang Fahe, Grand General Who Guards the North with staff equal to the three counsellors and Inspector of South Xuzhou, was made Grand General Who Guards the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou.
s0232.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dingchou day, Huang Fahe, grand general who guards the north with staff equal to the three counsellors and inspector of South Xuzhou, was made grand general who guards the south and inspector of Jiangzhou.

s0233.literal: In the ninth month, on renxu day, Ouyang Yi, Grand Mentor with staff equal to the three counsellors and Inspector of Guangzhou, died.
s0233.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renxu day, Ouyang Yi, grand mentor with staff equal to the three counsellors and inspector of Guangzhou, died.

s0234.literal: On guihai day a partial amnesty was granted to the capital.
s0234.idiomatic: On guihai day the capital received a partial amnesty.

s0235.literal: On xinwei day Zhou Di again raided Linchuan; an edict ordered Protector General Zhang Zhaoda to lead the armies to attack him.
s0235.idiomatic: On xinwei day Zhou Di raided Linchuan again; an edict sent Protector General Zhang Zhaoda against him.

s0236.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinyou day, Zhang Zhaoda inflicted a great defeat on Zhou Di, captured all his partisans, and Di himself slipped away in secret flight.
s0236.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinyou day, Zhang Zhaoda routed Zhou Di, seized his whole following, and Di escaped in hiding.

s0237.literal: In the twelfth month, on jingshen day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0237.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jingshen day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

s0238.literal: An edict ordered Protector General Zhang Zhaoda to advance the army into Jian'an to attack Chen Baoying.
s0238.idiomatic: An edict ordered Protector General Zhang Zhaoda to march on Jian'an against Chen Baoying.

s0239.literal: Yu Xiaoxiang, Trustworthy and Martial General and Inspector of Yizhou, was to take overall command of the armies of Kuaiji, Dongyang, Linhai, and Yongjia from the eastern route to join him.
s0239.idiomatic: Yu Xiaoxiang, trustworthy and martial general and inspector of Yizhou, was to command Kuaiji, Dongyang, Linhai, and Yongjia troops from the east to link up with him.

s0240.literal: On guichou day the former General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou, Wu Mingche, was made General Who Guards the Van.
s0240.idiomatic: On guichou day Wu Mingche, former general who pacifies the south and inspector of Jiangzhou, was made general who guards the van.

s0241.literal: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on gengchen day, Yuan Shu, Minister of the Ministry of Personnel and concurrent General of the Right Army, was made Governor of Danyang.
s0241.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on gengchen day, Yuan Shu, minister of the ministry of personnel and general of the right army, was made governor of Danyang.

s0242.literal: On xinsi day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Northern Suburb.
s0242.idiomatic: On xinsi day the emperor sacrificed in person at the Northern Suburb.

s0243.literal: On yiyou day a fire broke out at Pencheng in Jiangzhou; more than two hundred people died in the blaze.
s0243.idiomatic: On yiyou day fire destroyed Pencheng in Jiangzhou, killing more than two hundred people.

s0244.literal: In the third month, on dingchou day, Chunyu Liang, Grand General Who Campaigns South with staff equal to the three counsellors and Inspector of Guizhou, was made Grand General Who Pacifies the Center.
s0244.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingchou day, Chunyu Liang, grand general who campaigns south with staff equal to the three counsellors and inspector of Guizhou, was made grand general who pacifies the center.

s0245.literal: On renwu day an edict ordered the late Protector General Zhou Tiehu to receive offerings in the Founder Emperor's temple hall.
s0245.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict placed the late Protector General Zhou Tiehu in the roster of sacrifices at the Founder Emperor's temple.

s0246.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengzi day, Zhou sent envoys on a friendly mission.
s0246.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengzi day, Northern Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.

s0247.literal: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, South Danyang commandery was abolished.
s0247.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, South Danyang commandery was abolished.

s0248.literal: That month Zhou and Qi both sent envoys on friendly missions.
s0248.idiomatic: That month both Northern Zhou and Northern Qi sent friendly embassies.

s0249.literal: In the sixth month, on dingwei day, at night, two white vapors issued southeast of the Northern Dipper and reached the ground.
s0249.idiomatic: On the night of dingwei in the sixth month, two white rays rose southeast of the Big Dipper and touched the earth.

s0250.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingchou day, an edict said: "We, being slight and dull, have been set to bear a heavy burden; the year's markers change in quick succession, yet We do not neglect the imperial cap; We cannot look up to harmonize the celestial balance, use it to tune the jade measure, and by that means comfort the blue-clad people and settle the black-haired masses.
s0250.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingchou day, an edict declared: "We are unworthy yet bear the throne; years turn quickly, yet We never neglect the crown. We cannot align Heaven's scale, adjust the jade tally, and so comfort the people and give the masses peace.

s0251.literal: The armies know no year of rest, the people lack years of plenty; the way of shifting customs is not yet broadly spread, the harm of entrenched habits still remains, so that the common folk often touch the net, clerks multiply brush-and-knife work, prisons and cages grow more numerous—though this comes from things offending the law, yet in the jails the detained linger long, and among them there are also the wrongly accused.
s0251.idiomatic: War gives the land no quiet year; the people know lean harvests. Reform has not gone far enough, old abuses remain, and too many commoners fall into the law. Clerks multiply their records; prisons swell. Some suffer through their own crimes, but many linger in chains who may be innocent.

s0252.literal: Thinking how the people are like those about to fall into the moat, We toil at the throne-back screen; moreover Our skin and flesh are ill at ease and Our regimen of care is impaired; having lately obtained slight recovery, We wish to spread broad mercy—a partial amnesty may be granted to the capital."
s0252.idiomatic: Remembering the people on the brink of ruin, We labor at the throne; Our health too has failed and Our care of the body is wanting. Now that We are somewhat recovered, We mean to show wide mercy: let the capital receive a partial amnesty."

s0253.literal: In the ninth month the western city was walled.
s0253.idiomatic: In the ninth month work walled the western quarter of the capital.

s0254.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on dinghai day, Cheng Lingxi, General of the Left Guard, was made Central Bulwark General.
s0254.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on dinghai day, Cheng Lingxi, general of the left guard, was made central bulwark general.

s0255.literal: On jichou day Zhang Zhaoda defeated Chen Baoying at Jian'an, captured Baoying and Liu Yi, and sent them to the capital; Jin'an commandery was pacified.
s0255.idiomatic: On jichou day Zhang Zhaoda defeated Chen Baoying at Jian'an, seized Baoying and Liu Yi, and sent them to the capital; Jin'an commandery was pacified.

s0256.literal: On jiachen day Protector General Zhang Zhaoda was made General Who Guards the Van with staff equal to the three counsellors.
s0256.idiomatic: On jiachen day Protector General Zhang Zhaoda was made general who guards the van with staff equal to the three counsellors.

s0257.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiazi day, a partial amnesty was granted to Jian'an and Jin'an commanderies.
s0257.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiazi day, Jian'an and Jin'an commanderies received a partial amnesty.

s0258.literal: Officers and soldiers who died in service campaigning against Chen Baoying were all provided coffins and sent back to their native districts, and their families were restored.
s0258.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers who fell against Chen Baoying were given coffins and sent home, and their families were restored to standing.

s0259.literal: Those whose wounds were not yet healed were given medicine.
s0259.idiomatic: The wounded who had not yet recovered were supplied with medicine.

s0260.literal: On guiwei day Qi sent envoys on a friendly mission.
s0260.idiomatic: On guiwei day Northern Qi sent envoys on a friendly visit.

s0261.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on jiawu day, the crown prince received the capping of adulthood; kings, dukes, and those below were each granted silk according to rank; those noted for filial piety, brotherly duty, and farming vigor who were heirs received one rank of nobility; widows, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves received five hu of grain per person.
s0261.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on jiawu day, the crown prince came of age; princes and officials received graded gifts of silk; filial farmers who were heirs gained one rank of nobility; and widows, orphans, and the destitute received five hu of grain each.

s0262.literal: On gengxu day Du Ling, General of the Garrison Army, was made Left Assistant General and Governor of Danyang; Yuan Shu, Governor of Danyang, was made Minister of the Ministry of Personnel; and Shen Qin, Chamberlain for the Palace Revenues, was made General of the Garrison Army.
s0262.idiomatic: On gengxu day Du Ling, general of the garrison army, became left assistant general and governor of Danyang; Yuan Shu, governor of Danyang, became minister of the ministry of personnel; and Shen Qin, chamberlain for the palace revenues, became general of the garrison army.

s0263.literal: In the third month, on yiwei day, an edict said that from the time of Hou Jing's rebellion onward, those displaced by disorder and moved into Jian'an, Jin'an, and Yi'an commanderies were all permitted to return to their native places; those seized and made slaves or bondmaids were released as commoners.
s0263.idiomatic: In the third month, on yiwei day, an edict allowed everyone displaced since Hou Jing's rebellion into Jian'an, Jin'an, and Yi'an to go home, and ordered those taken as slaves or bondmaids freed as commoners.

s0264.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin day, the King of Ancheng, Xu, Palace Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, Central Guard General, Grand General of Cavalry with staff equal to the three counsellors, and Inspector of Yangzhou, was made Minister of Works.
s0264.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin day, the King of Ancheng, Xu, palace attendant, director of the secretariat, central guard general, grand general of cavalry with staff equal to the three counsellors, and inspector of Yangzhou, was made minister of works.

s0265.literal: On xinyou day a comet appeared.
s0265.idiomatic: On xinyou day a comet was seen.

s0266.literal: [18] Zhou sent envoys on a friendly mission.
s0266.idiomatic: [18] Northern Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.

s0267.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiwei day, a great wind came from the southwest, more than a hundred paces wide, and struck and destroyed the Spirit Terrace observation tower.
s0267.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiwei day, a gale from the southwest, over a hundred paces across, wrecked the Spirit Terrace watchtower.

s0268.literal: On jiashen day the Hall for Honoring the Worthy collapsed for no apparent reason.
s0268.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Hall for Honoring the Worthy collapsed without evident cause.

s0269.literal: On jingxu day Linchuan Governor Luo Wenya beheaded Zhou Di; [19] the head was sent to the capital and exposed at the Vermilion Bird landing.
s0269.idiomatic: On jingxu day Luo Wenya, governor of Linchuan, executed Zhou Di; [19] the head was sent to the capital and displayed at the Vermilion Bird landing.

s0270.literal: On dingyou day the Metal Star was seen in daylight.
s0270.idiomatic: On dingyou day Venus appeared by day.

s0271.literal: In the eighth month, on dingchou day, an edict said: "The House of Liang suffered many troubles; calamity followed calamity; armor and weapons were in turmoil for ten years without respite; unbridled men vented cruelty on the living breath, and worthless sorts brought violence even upon the departed souls.
s0271.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingchou day, an edict declared: "The Liang house knew endless trouble; disaster followed disaster; arms did not rest for ten years; the lawless ravaged the living, and the vile afflicted the dead.

s0272.literal: When the southeast first laid its foundations, it was the dwelling of kings; rulers of the Metal phase and Water phase, and sovereigns of the Wood phase and Fire phase, in all four successions, for more than two hundred years.
s0272.idiomatic: When the southeast first rose, it was the seat of kings—sovereigns of metal and water, wood and fire, four lines in all, spanning more than two hundred years.

s0273.literal: As for their weaving the realm

s0275.literal: [wang] enterprise, [20] the gentry's esteem and the people's hope, loyal ministers and filial sons—what age lacks talent? [21] Yet they lie scattered on the hills, tombs and valleys have shifted, or all were cut down—none escaped violation and ruin.
s0275.idiomatic: [wang] enterprise, [20] the gentry's honor and the people's hope—loyal ministers and filial sons appear in every age, [21] yet they lie ruined on the hills, graves and valleys have shifted, and many were cut down until nothing was left unspoiled.

s0276.literal: Jade cups were obtained among the people, lacquered documents passed down through generations, but there were no longer trees of five trunks, and tables a thousand years old were rarely seen.
s0276.idiomatic: Jade cups survived among the people and lacquered books in family stores, but the five-trunk trees were gone and thousand-year tablets seldom seen.

s0277.literal: From the time the great mandate brightly opened, reverently yielding the throne down to Our own person, We have continued the ancestral martial way; though banners, flags, and dress still follow the states of Qi and Song,
s0277.idiomatic: Since the great mandate dawned, from the reverent yielding of the throne down to Our own reign, We have kept the ancestral way; though banners and dress still follow the model of Qi and Song,

s0279.literal: [state], [22] whenever the imperial carriage tours, We gaze from afar on the roads to the Yellow River and Luo; therefore the sacrifices at Mount Qiao are not neglected, water-chestnut and pondweed are not wanting, and at Mount Li's tombs the pines and cypresses are ever kept.
s0279.idiomatic: [state], [22] whenever We tour, We look toward the Yellow River and Luo; the rites at Mount Qiao are not neglected, offerings are not wanting, and at Mount Li the pines and cypresses stand guard.

s0280.literal: Only the old mounds of imperial kinsmen and the former graves of scholars and officers were not fully covered in burial; woodcutters and herdsmen still thronged them.
s0280.idiomatic: Only the old tombs of imperial kin and the graves of scholars and officers were not fully tended; woodcutters and herdsmen still swarmed there.

s0281.literal: Some kinsmen were cast into bondage and could find no day to heap the earth; descendants perished in obscurity, and the trees they planted with their own hands had no one to keep them.
s0281.idiomatic: Some kin were sold into bondage and could not mound the earth in time; lines died out in silence, and the trees they planted had no keeper.

s0282.literal: Han Gaozu lingered in grief at Wuji's tomb, and the Song founder was filled with sorrow at Zifang's grave—tombs can stir pity, and the inner heart shares the ache.
s0282.idiomatic: Han Gaozu mourned at Wuji's tomb, and the Song founder grieved at Zhang Liang's grave—tombs move the heart, and spirit feels the same sorrow.

s0283.literal: [23] This is why We speak all day and think to comfort the dark springs.
s0283.idiomatic: [23] That is why We speak of it through the day and wish to comfort the dead below.

s0284.literal: As for former dynasties' kings and marquises, and loyal and fierce men of old whose tombs were disheveled and utterly without heirs, an inspection may be made and repairs carried out; trees within the tombs must not be cut for fuel or gathered—so that the hidden and the manifest may alike be at ease, in accord with Our intent."
s0284.idiomatic: Former kings and marquises, and loyal and fierce men of old whose graves lie ruined and without heirs, shall be sought out and repaired; trees in the tombs must not be cut for fuel—so that the living and the dead may be at peace, as We desire."

s0285.literal: On jimao day the princes Bogu, Bogong, Boren, and Boyi were enfeoffed as Kings of Xin'an, Jin'an, Luling, and Jiangxia.
s0285.idiomatic: On jimao day Princes Bogu, Bogong, Boren, and Boyi were enfeoffed as kings of Xin'an, Jin'an, Luling, and Jiangxia.

s0286.literal: In the ninth month, on guiwei day, Yuzhang commandery was abolished.
s0286.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiwei day, Yuzhang commandery was abolished.

s0287.literal: That month a new Great Floating Bridge was built.
s0287.idiomatic: That month a new Great Floating Bridge was constructed.

s0288.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinhai day, Qi sent envoys on a friendly mission.
s0288.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinhai day, Northern Qi sent envoys on a friendly visit.

s0289.literal: In the twelfth month, on yimao day, the Prince of Wuling, Boli, was enfeoffed as king.
s0289.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yimao day, Prince Boli was enfeoffed as King of Wuling.

s0290.literal: On dingsi day Zhang Zhaoda, General Who Guards the Van with staff equal to the three counsellors, was made Grand General Who Guards the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou; Huang Fahe, Grand General Who Guards the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou, was made Grand Central Guard General; Cheng Lingxi, Central Bulwark General, was made Trustworthy and Martial General and Inspector of Yingzhou; Shen Ke, Military Adviser General and Inspector of Yingzhou, was made Central Bulwark General; and Wu Mingche, General Who Guards the East and Governor of Wuxing, was made General of the Garrison Army.
s0290.idiomatic: On dingsi day Zhang Zhaoda, general who guards the van with staff equal to the three counsellors, became grand general who guards the south and inspector of Jiangzhou; Huang Fahe, grand general who guards the south and inspector of Jiangzhou, became grand central guard general; Cheng Lingxi, central bulwark general, became trustworthy and martial general and inspector of Yingzhou; Shen Ke, military adviser general and inspector of Yingzhou, became central bulwark general; and Wu Mingche, general who guards the east and governor of Wuxing, became general of the garrison army.

s0291.literal: On wuwu day the King of Poyang, Boshan, Eastern Central Commander and Governor of Wu commandery, was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of South Xuzhou.
s0291.idiomatic: On wuwu day the King of Poyang, Boshan, eastern central commander and governor of Wu commandery, was made general who pacifies the north and inspector of South Xuzhou.

s0292.literal: On guihai day an edict said: "Since We undertook the heavy charge of nurturing the people and were set above kings and dukes, We have seen Our own dullness and been troubled in the way of rule.
s0292.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict declared: "Since We took on the burden of caring for the people and were set above kings and dukes, We have known Our own dullness and been troubled at governing.

s0293.literal: Moreover We have repeatedly impaired Our hearing and sight; affairs have piled up in obstruction; grievances held in detention are not cleared, and the hidden and wronged are not examined.
s0293.idiomatic: Again and again Our health has failed; business has piled up blocked; prisoners' grievances go unheard, and hidden wrongs are not judged.

s0294.literal: Thinking of these who bear guilt and fetters, it is like those about to fall into the moat.
s0294.idiomatic: Thinking of those in chains, We feel as though the people stood on the brink of ruin.

s0295.literal: Yet Our favor has not flowed forth; for successive months the yang has been out of balance; now the year's sequence draws to its end and the new year is about to begin—We wish those within the dark prisons likewise to share the season's harmony; a partial amnesty may be granted to the capital."
s0295.idiomatic: Yet mercy has not gone out; drought has lingered for months. The year ends and the new year nears—We wish even those in prison to share the season's peace: let the capital receive a partial amnesty."

s0296.literal: In the second month of spring of the first year of Tiankang, on jingzi day, an edict said: "We, being slight in virtue, have succeeded to the great succession; from sun to sun We toil, thinking to expand the bright enterprise—yet the way of government is much obscure, the black-haired masses are not yet at ease; moreover Our illness has lingered long, and drought has piled up for months; what fault is it of the common people? Truly it lies in Our own person; thinking of this, thinking of this, the pain is like a wound in the head.
s0296.idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the first year of Tiankang, on jingzi day, an edict declared: "We are unworthy yet have inherited the great line. Day and night We labor to enlarge the bright work, yet government is still unclear and the people are not at ease. Illness has lingered, drought has lasted for months—the people are blameless; the fault is Ours alone. The thought of it pains Us like a wound in the head.

s0297.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm; the seventh year of Tianjia is changed to the first year of Tiankang."
s0297.idiomatic: Let there be a general amnesty, and let the seventh year of Tianjia become the first year of Tiankang."

s0298.literal: In the third month, on jimao day, the King of Ancheng, Xu, Grand General of Cavalry with staff equal to the three counsellors and Inspector of Yangzhou and Minister of Works, was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
s0298.idiomatic: In the third month, on jimao day, the King of Ancheng, Xu, grand general of cavalry with staff equal to the three counsellors, inspector of Yangzhou, and minister of works, was made director of the masters of writing.

s0299.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yimao day, an imperial grandson, Ze, was born; civil and military officials in post were each granted silk and brocade according to rank; heirs received one rank of nobility.
s0299.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yimao day, an imperial grandson, Ze, was born; officials received graded gifts of silk and brocade, and heirs one rank of nobility.

s0300.literal: On guiyou day Emperor Wen's illness grew severe.
s0300.idiomatic: On guiyou day Emperor Wen's illness grew critical.
